T1.note: unit + demos + non-Docker integration (integration/services subtree excluded - it is Docker-real and runs in T2); floor = measured minus ~2% slack. Raised for 12.3, then 12.2.6 (test tie-back), then 12.4, then 12.5 (usage channel), and now 12.6. Re-measured 2062 -> 2403 after the whole 12.6 wave landed, NOT guessed: +341 net from the wire protocol / runner-token / registry / runner-model suites, the recovery + dispatcher + remote-executor contract suites, the ws-endpoint handshake matrix, the requirement-grammar suite, the rebuilt verify_executor gate tests (32 -> 47, covering assertions 8-12 with a negative case each), and test_no_legacy_code (30) - minus the polling suites deleted with their subsystems (test_runner_pool, test_job_queue, test_runners_api, test_runner.py). 55 of the gain are the previously-DORMANT tdd/unit/execution contract tests, which now run unmodified: `pytest ../tdd/unit ../tdd/demos ../tdd/integration --ignore=../tdd/integration/services -m 'not slow'` reports 2403 passed with ZERO skips, and the '12.6-dormant:' skip_baseline entry was removed in the deletion commit because it can no longer match. Raise when suites grow (ratchet up, never down without a PLAN.md note).

T2.note: Docker-dependent integration (tdd/integration/services: executor + 12.2-INT workspace lifecycle/local pipeline/WS round-trip suites + 12.3 HOME-persistence + base-image contracts + 12.5 agent-step container). Docker down fails loudly in the shared docker_client fixture (tdd/integration/conftest.py). Step images are a PREFLIGHT: run_tier.py T2 runs `build_images.py --check` before pytest. Re-measured 64 -> 70 for 12.6's LOOPBACK LANE (tdd/integration/services/execution/test_loopback_runner.py + test_loopback_failover.py): a real `python -m lazyaf_runner` subprocess speaking the real WebSocket protocol to a real backend, executing a pinned step in a control-mode container it spawned on its own daemon, from a workspace volume it created and cloned itself. DIRECTORY NOTE (stated, not silent): the 12.6 design placed these at tdd/integration/execution/; they live under services/execution/ instead because scripts/run_tier.py selects T2 as `tdd/integration/services` and T1 as everything else under tdd/integration - a Docker-real suite outside services/ would run in the NO-DOCKER tier and fail there. Same tier the design asks for, correct directory for it. The one baselined skip is the e2e-lane real-http population clone.

T3.note: e2e quick tier (tdd/e2e -m 'not slow'). Raised at 12.5 for tdd/e2e/test_us2_card_loop.py - the US-2 loop (card -> agent -> gate -> review -> merge) is deliberately NOT slow: it runs against the mock agent at zero cost, so US-2 is covered on every push. UNCHANGED at 12.6 by design: the count is the same 19, but what one of them asserts changed. test_us2_card_loop used to prove 'nothing enqueued' by spying on job_queue.enqueue; the queue was deleted, so it now reads StepRun.executor back through the API instead - the durable half of the same claim. US-2 remains covered on the LOCAL path here while the dogfood pipeline's migrated `mock-agent` step covers it on the REMOTE path every push. T3 also has the same `build_images.py --check` preflight T2 has (scripts/run_tier.py), because agent steps spawn lazyaf-agent-base:dev containers. Known exclusion (R4, stated not silent): the @slow e2e tests run in NO tier and have no floor here - they need the compose e2e stack, which a step container cannot host yet. Host-runnable via the scripts/test slow lane. Tier selections are single-sourced in scripts/run_tier.py.
